test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A right circular conical vessel has a capacity of 9240 m³. The radius of the cone is 21 m. What will be the total cost (in ₹) of painting the outer curved surface area of cone at the rate of ₹10/m²?

Take π =22/7
solution:
**Given:**

Volume of cone (V) = 9240 m³

Radius (r) = 21 m

Rate = ₹10 per m²

π = 22/7

**Formula used:**

V = (1/3) × π × r² × h

l = √(r² + h²)

CSA = π × r × l
